# Official Beam client fixture

Unmodified MIT-licensed source from [openclaw/agent-skills](https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/tree/b637385f21ab78ada03d87bba25e16aa9f192404) at `b637385f21ab78ada03d87bba25e16aa9f192404`. The joined Gateway regression executes this client with synthetic data and normal fixture device pairing. Update the owning client first, then refresh these exact files together.
